thag9.1:1.1: Aṭṭhanipāto niṭṭhito. NAVANIPĀTO. Yadā dukkhaṃ jarāmaraṇan ti paṇḍito aviddasū yattha sitā puthujjanā dukkhaṃ pariññāya sato 'va jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati. || ||
thag9.1:2.1: yadā dukkhassāvahaniṃ visattikaṃ papañcasaṃghāṭadukhādhivāhaniṃ taṇhaṃ pahatvāna sato 'va jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati. || ||
thag9.1:3.1: yadā sivaṃ dvecaturaṅgagāminaṃ magguttamaṃ sabbakilesasodhanaṃ paññāya passitvā sato 'va jhāyati, tato . . . || || yadā asokaṃ virajaṃ asaṃkhataṃ
thag9.1:4.1: santaṃ padaṃ sabbakilesasodhanaṃ bhāveti saññojanabandhanacchidaṃ, tato . . . || || yadā nabhe gajjati meghadundubhi
thag9.1:5.1: dhārākulā vihaṅgapathe samantato bhikkhu ca pabbhāragato 'va jhāyati, tato . . . || || yadā nadīnaṃ kusumākulānaṃ vicittavāneyyavaṭaṃsakānaṃ
thag9.1:6.1: tīre nisinno sumano 'va jhāyati, tato . . . || || yadā nisīthe rahitamhi kānane
thag9.1:7.1: deve gaḷantamhi nadanti dāṭhino bhikkhu ca pabbhāragato 'va jhāyati, tato . . . || || yadā vitakke uparundhiy' attano
thag9.1:8.1: nagantare nagavivaraṃ samassito vītaddaro vigatakhilo 'va jhāyati, tato . . . || || yadā sukhī malakhilasokanāsano
thag9.1:9.1: niraggalo nibbanatho visallo sabbāsave byantikato 'va jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindatīti. || || Bhūto thero. uddānaṃ: Bhūto tathaddaso
thag9.1:10.0: thero eko khaggavisāṇavā Navakamhi nipātamhi, gāthāyo pi imā navā 'ti.
